user.title: Connect Voetbal.nl account
user.description: Sign in with your own Voetbal.nl account.

club_search.title: Search club
club_search.description: Enter (part of) a club name. Voetbal.nl searches nationwide.

team_select.title: Select teams
team_select.description: Select one or more teams. Duplicate names include match day and competition where available.

reconfigure.title: Manage teams
reconfigure.description: Add or remove teams. The integration reloads automatically afterwards.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Voetbal.nl or retrieve data.
error.no_clubs: No clubs found for this search.
error.no_teams: No teams found for this club.

abort.already_configured: This club has already been added for this account.

init.title: Configure HA Voetbal.nl
init.description: Choose what you want to manage. Each option briefly explains what can be configured there.

players.title: Player management — {team}
players.description: Select visible Voetbal.nl players for your local squad. Hidden players on Voetbal.nl: {hidden}. Add missing players manually, one name per line.

data_description.selected_players: Choose which visible Voetbal.nl players belong to the local squad.
data_description.manual_players: Add missing or hidden players manually, one name per line.

route.title: Route settings
route.description: Enter one OpenRouteService API key and choose the team whose departure point you want to configure.

route_team.title: Departure point — {team}
route_team.description: By default the home ground from Voetbal.nl is used: {home}. Choose Custom departure point to use another meeting point.

driving_team.title: Driving schedule
driving_team.description: Choose the team whose driving schedule you want to configure.

driving.title: Driving schedule — {team}
driving.description: Set cars per away match, exclude permanent drivers, and add date-specific driver unavailability. The planner first balances trips and then kilometres.

data.add_supplemental_schedule: Create supplemental schedule for new away matches

data_description.cars_per_away_match: Number of drivers/cars automatically scheduled for each away match.
data_description.excluded_drivers: These players are excluded as drivers for the entire season.
data_description.add_supplemental_schedule: Manual fallback. New away matches are normally supplemented automatically; existing assignments are preserved.
data_description.temporary_driver_unavailability: Enter player and date as Name | DD-MM-YYYY. The player is unavailable as a driver only on that date. Separate multiple entries with semicolons.

players_team.title: Player management
players_team.description: Choose the team whose players you want to manage.

training_team.title: Training schedule
training_team.description: Choose the team whose training schedule you want to manage.

training.title: Training schedule — {team}
training.description: Configure the training schedule start/end dates, sessions, school holidays and holiday overrides for {team}.

data.training_weather_enabled: Add weather forecast to training-day message
data.training_attendance_summary_enabled: Add attendance summary to training-day message
data.training_coach_enabled: Add Gemini coach message to training-day message

data_description.holiday_training_overrides: Enter multiple dates, one per line, using DD-MM-YYYY. The normal training continues on these dates even during a school holiday.
data_description.training_schedule_start: First date included when building the training schedule.
data_description.training_schedule_end: Last date included when building the training schedule.
data_description.production_enabled: On: new training polls are sent automatically to the production group. Off: no new production polls are started; existing active polls still complete, including reminder and closure at training start.
data_description.training_info_enabled: Automatically sends training information to the production group before training.
data_description.training_info_hours_before: Defaults to 2 hours before training starts.
data_description.training_weather_enabled: Uses the forecast around training start. Weather failures never block the message.
data_description.training_attendance_summary_enabled: Adds counts for present, absent, injured and no response.
data_description.training_coach_enabled: Generates roughly 60 words max. If Gemini fails, the training-day message is still sent without AI text.

match_team.title: Match settings
match_team.description: Choose the team whose match settings you want to manage.

match_settings.title: Match settings — {team}
match_settings.description: Manage settings used for match days. More match-specific options can be added here later.

data.match_present_minutes: Minutes before match to be present

data_description.match_present_minutes: Default is 45 minutes. For home matches it is subtracted from kickoff time; for away matches travel time is also subtracted.

whatsapp_start.title: WhatsApp / WAHA
whatsapp_start.description: Manage the WAHA connection or map WhatsApp groups to a football team.

data.waha_action: What do you want to manage?

whatsapp_connection.title: WAHA connection
whatsapp_connection.description: Enter the WAHA connection. It will be tested; no WhatsApp message is sent yet.

whatsapp_session.title: WAHA session
whatsapp_session.description: Select the active WhatsApp session. Groups will then be loaded.

whatsapp_load_groups.title: Load WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_load_groups.description: Groups could not be loaded. Check the WAHA connection and try again.

whatsapp_team.title: Map WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_team.description: Choose the football team for which you want to configure test and production groups.

whatsapp_identity_start.title: Refresh WhatsApp matching
whatsapp_identity_start.description: WhatsApp groups and their members are refreshed from WAHA before you create a mapping.

whatsapp_identity_team.title: WhatsApp matching — team
whatsapp_identity_team.description: Choose the HA/Voetbal.nl team for this WhatsApp identity mapping.

whatsapp_identity_group.title: WhatsApp matching — group
whatsapp_identity_group.description: Choose the WhatsApp group and whether this mapping is for production or test. The member list is refreshed now.

whatsapp_identity_mapping.title: WhatsApp matching — {team}
whatsapp_identity_mapping.description: Team: {team} · Group: {group}. Overview: {members}. All mappings are shown below. Set HA name ↔ WhatsApp name, type and Production/Test per person.

data_description.whatsapp_identity_wa_id: Select the WhatsApp contact exactly as WAHA reports it. The WA-ID is stored with the mapping.
data_description.whatsapp_identity_person: Select the person from the selected HA team.
data_description.whatsapp_identity_role: Choose Speler or Staf. The role must match the selected HA person.

whatsapp_groups.title: WhatsApp groups for {team}
whatsapp_groups.description: Choose the test and production group and decide per team whether WhatsApp uses attendance polls or information messages only.

data.matchday_weather_enabled: Add weather forecast to matchday message
data.matchday_coach_enabled: Add Gemini coach message to matchday message

data_description.production_enabled: On: new match polls are sent automatically to the production group. Off: no new production polls are started; existing active polls still complete, including reminder and closure at kickoff.
data_description.matchday_message_enabled: Automatically sends match information to the production group on matchday.
data_description.matchday_weather_enabled: Uses the forecast around kickoff at the match location. Weather failures never block the message.
data_description.matchday_coach_enabled: Generates roughly 60 words max. If Gemini fails, the matchday message is still sent without AI text.
data_description.assistant_name: Name used at the bottom of WhatsApp messages for this team. Default: De AI-Stafchef.
data_description.attendance_mode: Messages + polls: attendance polls and reminders stay active. Messages only (no polls): no attendance polls or poll reminders are sent; the existing match and training information messages remain active.

gemini.title: AI Coach / Gemini
gemini.description: Configure the shared Gemini connection. The API key is used only to generate short coach messages. If AI fails, the WhatsApp message is still sent without coach text.

data_description.gemini_api_key: Prefer a new Gemini auth key from Google AI Studio and treat it like a password.
data_description.gemini_model: Defaults to gemini-3.6-flash; you can change it later.

team_remove.title: Remove team
team_remove.description: Choose exactly one team. The full team name and team ID are shown. Only active teams can be removed.

team_remove_confirm.title: ⚠️ Remove team?
team_remove_confirm.description: You are about to remove **{team}** (team ID: `{team_id}`) from the active HA Voetbal.nl team selection. The other teams remain active. Saved configuration for this team is not automatically deleted.

match_tasks.title: Match tasks — {team}
match_tasks.description: Configure whether an assistant referee/flagger is required for this team. Select only the people who are allowed to flag. People who are not selected will not be scheduled as flagger. For away matches, the flagger must also be assigned as a driver. This planning is completely independent from the attendance poll.

data_description.enabled: On: plan an assistant referee/flagger for this team. Off: flagger planning is not used for this team.
data_description.flaggers: Select only people who are allowed to flag. ☑ Selected = may flag. Not selected = may NOT flag and is not used by the planner.
data_description.extra_flaggers: Optionally select additional people who may flag.
data_description.extra_flaggers_manual: Add people who are not in the player/staff list. Separate multiple names with commas or semicolons.
data_description.rebuild_match_tasks: Only enable this when you deliberately want to rebuild the existing match planning for this team. Existing driving and flagger assignments for this team will be replaced and recalculated. The attendance poll has no influence on this.

abort.team_not_found: The selected team was not found.

error.invalid_training_override_dates: Invalid date(s). Use exactly DD-MM-YYYY, one date per line.
error.invalid_training_period_dates: The training start or end date is invalid. Use DD-MM-YYYY.
error.training_period_end_before_start: The end date must be on or after the start date.
error.invalid_waha_url: The WAHA URL is invalid. Use http:// or https://.
error.invalid_webhook_url: The webhook base URL is invalid. Use http:// or https://.
error.cannot_connect_waha: Cannot connect to WAHA. Check URL and API key.
error.cannot_load_waha_groups: Cannot load WhatsApp groups from WAHA.
error.choose_waha_groups: Choose both a test group and a production group.
error.waha_groups_must_differ: Test group and production group must be different.
error.invalid_poll_time: Use a valid time in HH:MM format, for example 19:00.
error.reminder_before_poll: The reminder must be scheduled after the poll.
error.no_waha_group_members: No WhatsApp members could be loaded for this group.
error.no_team_people: The selected team has no configured players or staff.
error.identity_role_person_mismatch: The selected role does not match the selected HA person.
error.cannot_connect_gemini: The Gemini API key or selected model could not be validated.
error.team_not_active: This team is not active in the current selection.
error.cannot_remove_last_team: The last active team cannot be removed. At least one team must remain active.
error.team_not_found: The selected team could not be found.
